brief:
Israeli settlers grazed their sheep among Palestinian residential homes in the Jabel Mufeed area of Arraba, south of Jenin, Saturday evening, according to Shehab Wire. The grazing operation occurred amid the homes of local residents in the populated neighborhood.

Israeli occupation forces provided protection and security for the settlers during the incident. The episode marks another instance of settler activity in Palestinian communities, where such operations have become a recurring source of friction between settlers and residents.
